bounded_static_path.input: A generic text-line event parser receives text and calls a callback with a parsed event object.
bounded_static_path.collector: The callback adds the event to a local collector; the collector is finalized and its shared pointer is copied into a keyed entry.
bounded_static_path.key_domain: Not assigned in this bounded path.
bounded_static_path.first_consumer: The callback target is the same generic first per-event consumer used by the separate typed storage-event path.
bounded_static_path.identity_limit: A shared code target does not establish shared event-owner or generation identity.
